primary_topic: Clearance-Aware Commitment (CAC): 几何余量感知的动作块提交（robomimic Square + Diffusion Policy）
remaining_uncertainties: Official Square-MH checkpoint is publicly listed (~4 GB) but has not been downloaded or loaded locally.
Local DP Square baseline and compatibility with the current robomimic/MuJoCo stack are unverified.
Whether fixed horizon affects whole-episode success on local Square-MH remains unknown.
Whether horizon effects vary with signed geometric clearance at matched pre-insertion states remains the core Gate B v2 test.
Whether simulator collision geometry can be exposed reliably for the signed clearance calculation is unverified.
Whether the local environment can snapshot/restore or deterministically replay matched pre-insertion states is unverified.
Whether always-short is already best, or whether an adaptive oracle has a meaningful advantage over the best fixed horizon, remains unknown.
2609.00908 and 2607.01804 remain abstract-level competitors; exact behavior on DP/Square is not yet compared.

The original Diffusion Policy paper notes that its robomimic evaluation code used 22 initial conditions rather than the nominal 50; Gate B will use a new, explicitly recorded set of 100 initial states.
